crossRefs.note: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the…
But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his…
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…

translations.web: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
translations.bsb: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
translations.kjv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
translations.asv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.
